summary: Generalized the 3 static miners to target ANY repo via --repo/--out flags (new files, didn't touch the self-hardcoded ingest-*.js). scripts/onboard-mine-structure.js (recursive walk + JS/TS require/import resolution → structure.json), onboard-mine-git.js (same high-signal commit heuristic, repo-arg + per-subject out), onboard-mine-docs.js (NEW heuristic doc distiller: cue-based rationale-sentence extraction since the old ingest-docs.js was a curated per-file map that doesn't generalize). All node --check clean. Verified on the orchestrator repo itself: 31 nodes/28 edges, 22 git-notes, 137 doc candidates. Outputs land in bench/onboard/<repo-basename>/. Work isolated in worktree orch/attempt/onboarding-kb.
